metadata.scenario: A patient calls to cancel tomorrow's physical therapy session because they have a family emergency. They don't want to reschedule yet and will call back next week. Polite but brief.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Harold Gonzalez. I need to cancel my physical therapy session scheduled for tomorrow. Hi, Harold! I'm sorry to hear that. Is everything okay? Yes, just a family emergency that came up. I understand. Family emergencies can happen. Would you like me to go ahead and cancel that for you? Yes, please. Alright, I've canceled your physical therapy session for tomorrow. Thank you. I don’t want to reschedule just yet. I’ll call back next week. That sounds good, Harold. Just let us know when you’re ready to reschedule. Also, can I ask if there are any other services you think might help me? Absolutely! Since you’re managing COPD and require frequent vital sign checks, you might consider skilled nursing visits for regular monitoring. That might be helpful. How much is it? Skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125 for a visit lasting 1-2 hours. Okay, I’ll think about it. Great! If you have any questions or decide you’d like to start those visits, just give me a call. I will, thanks. I appreciate your understanding. Of course, Harold. Family comes first. Yes, it does. Have a good day, Margaret. You too, Harold. Take care!
